rules.statement: Execution pending appeal may be stayed under section 763 where the judgment-debtor satisfies the Court that substantial loss to him may otherwise result.
rules.supporting_quote: "Execution pending appeal may be stayed under section 763 where the judgment-debtor satisfies the Court that 'substantial loss to him may otherwise result (Charlotte Perera v. Thambiah (1), while some consideration of the degree of hardship to the judgment-creditor may perhaps be relevant, especially in borderline cases, there is certainly no burden on him to establish comparatively greater hardship as a condition of the grant of execution."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 763 of the Civil Procedure Code
